description.en: Graph showing the variation of binding energy per nucleon ($BE/A$) with mass number ($A$). It highlights the regions of nuclear fusion and fission.
description.hi: द्रव्यमान संख्या ($A$) के साथ प्रति न्यूक्लिऑन बंधन ऊर्जा ($BE/A$) के परिवर्तन को दर्शाने वाला ग्राफ। यह नाभिकीय संलयन और विखंडन के क्षेत्रों को उजागर करता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 550 350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Axes -->
  <line x1="60" y1="300" x2="500" y2="300" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- X-axis (Mass Number A) -->
  <line x1="60" y1="300" x2="60" y2="40" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- Y-axis (BE/A) -->

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="240" y="335" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">Mass Number (A)</text>
  <text x="20" y="200" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563" transform="rotate(-90 20,200)">BE/A (MeV/nucleon)</text>

  <!-- X-axis Ticks -->
  <text x="100" y="315" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">50</text>
  <text x="180" y="315" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">100</text>
  <text x="260" y="315" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">150</text>
  <text x="340" y="315" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">200</text>
  <text x="420" y="315" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">250</text>

  <!-- Y-axis Ticks -->
  <text x="45" y="265" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">2</text>
  <text x="45" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">4</text>
  <text x="45" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">6</text>
  <text x="45" y="115" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">8</text>
  <text x="38" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">10</text>
  <text x="45" y="315" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">0</text>

  <!-- Grid Lines (optional, keeping minimal) -->
  <line x1="60" y1="115" x2="500" y2="115" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

  <!-- The Curve -->
  <path d="M 65 290 Q 75 140 85 110 Q 110 80 140 95 Q 200 110 300 120 Q 400 140 480 165" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" />

  <!-- Key Nuclei Points (Approximate positions) -->
  <circle cx="75" cy="200" r="3" fill="#ef4444" /> <text x="80" y="210" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">²H</text>
  <circle cx="80" cy="125" r="3" fill="#ef4444" /> <text x="65" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">⁴He</text>
  <circle cx="110" cy="95" r="3" fill="#ef4444" /> <text x="110" y="85" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">⁵⁶Fe</text>
  <circle cx="450" cy="155" r="3" fill="#ef4444" /> <text x="450" y="170" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">²³⁸U</text>

  <!-- Fusion Region Annotation -->
  <rect x="80" y="250" width="80" height="20" rx="10" fill="#10b981" opacity="0.2" />
  <text x="90" y="265" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#047857">Fusion →</text>

  <!-- Fission Region Annotation -->
  <rect x="380" y="200" width="80" height="20" rx="10" fill="#f59e0b" opacity="0.2" />
  <text x="385" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#b45309">← Fission</text>

  <!-- Max Stability Region -->
  <line x1="110" y1="75" x2="110" y2="90" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="75" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563">Max Stability (8.8 MeV)</text>

</svg>

text.hi: 30 < A < 170 के लिए चौड़ा उच्चिष्ठ (~8.5 MeV)
